tip: Use 御覧 when you want to politely ask someone to look at something; it is the honorific form of 見る and is common in formal writing, announcements, and customer‑service language. It typically appears with ください (御覧ください) or in the respectful expression 御覧いただく. Avoid using 御覧 in casual speech with friends, where plain 見る or 観る is preferred.
example: このカタログを御覧ください。
